# Halloween Night · Inline Metal Shader Movie
A six-second, 30 fps Halloween postcard. A large web fills the left corner and a smaller web balances the right; a spider hangs from the larger one. Three squat, unevenly ribbed jack-o-lanterns glow beneath falling wrapped candy and candy corn. Colored magic motes rise through the scene while distant lightning flashes several times. All artwork is generated by the Text node shader; no texture or model is required. JSON State advances time by 1/30 second per Loop call. The finite 180-call Loop feeds Video Output, which saves one 640 × 360 H.264 MP4.
